items.title: 13-year-old Critical Redis RCE vulnerability Let Attackers Gain Full Access to Host System
items.description: A 13-year-old critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Redis, dubbed #RediShell, allows attackers to gain full access to the underlying host system. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2025-49844, was discovered by Wiz Research and has been assigned the highest possible CVSS severity score of 10.0, a rating reserved for the most severe security issues.
